svg.title: 04 · Analyzer
svg.desc: Inside the run worker, the KPI gate answers with a preset query when one fits; otherwise the Claim Query Agent, fed by its example bank, cached references and prompts, writes CLI calls with SQL that pass the SQL guard on the way to the DuckDB query service.

g.text: Claude Haiku · first: answer, clarify or escalate

svg.text: The Claim Query Agent is the run worker: one Fargate task per run, Claude Haiku on Amazon Bedrock.
